This '''unidentified Iego structure''' was a building in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]] on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. A large [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] marquee stated the name of the establishment.

==Behind the scenes==
Only parts of the marquee can be seen in the episode. It says "''[obscured]''DADEL".
